chapters.1: Jude urges his readers to contend earnestly for the faith because false teachers have secretly infiltrated the church, twisting God's grace into an excuse for immoral living. He reminds them of past examples of God's judgment on rebellious people, including unbelieving Israelites, fallen angels, and Sodom and Gomorrah, and describes these infiltrators as self-indulgent and spiritually empty, while encouraging true believers to build themselves up in faith, stay in God's love, and show mercy to those who waver, closing with a doxology praising God's power to keep them from falling.
